data.narrative:
Jimmy Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Antoine Guyot and Mathilde Grivet that has raised €80M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 total companies—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers in nuclear energy at seed through Series B stages, including Valar Atomics, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, Oklo, and X-Energy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression anchors to the €80M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $160M. Peer-Median derives from three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Valar Atomics at $6.0B (Series B), Nano Nuclear Energy at $808M (Seed), and Fuse Energy at $200M (Series A). The median across these three is $808M, with a range of $200M to $6.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $136M (low) to $929M (high), with a median of $484M across the two methods. The wide dispersion—driven by extreme variance in peer stage advancement and absolute valuations—reflects material uncertainty around Jimmy Energy's relative position within the nuclear sector. The $200M–$808M band may represent a tighter range if Fuse Energy (same stage) and the peer median are weighted more heavily than the outlier $6.0B Series B comparable.
